homepage.welcomeTag: ⚡ WELCOME TO AMERICAN FITNESS GYM & ATHLETIC ARENA
homepage.description: Step into American Fitness Gym—a 20,000 sq. ft. world-class strength arena and athletic performance center. Equipped with competition-grade Rogue Monster rigs, Eleiko calibrated plates, Woodway cardio engines, 1-on-1 certified master biomechanics coaches, an infrared recovery spa, and an organic fuel protein bar. Built for those who demand excellence 24/7/365.
